author: reek
body: A text overlay: the string "CODEX GPU" drawn from a 5x7 bitmap font, scrolling as a marquee over a soft gradient, with a subtle drop shadow. One GPU thread per pixel maps to a character cell and a glyph pixel; the glyph table is an if-ladder of 5-bit rows. Reference site's "text overlay" technique. Float math from DeviceMath.

author: reek
body: A pixel is text if the glyph bit at its cell is set. A shifted lookup gives a drop shadow. Marquee scrolls with the frame.
